courses.summary: 吉拉索爾是 Block 17 浮式生產中心之一；課程以共用處理設施與海底連接的長期維護為主題。本課依序分析中心設施維修等待、連接管段壓降、海底接口檢驗趨勢、多來源液體分離、分配計量的誤差，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Girassol is a Block 17 floating hub; this case examines long-term upkeep of shared processing and subsea links. The course analyses hub-maintenance waiting, tieback-segment pressure loss, subsea-interface inspection trend, separation of multiple liquid sources, uncertainty in allocation metering, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
